name: io.github.tastytrade/tastytrade-mcp
title: tastytrade
description: Agent access to tastytrade brokerage accounts: quotes, positions, and dry-run-gated order flow.

toolSurface.note: Twelve destructive tools. Five — place_order, edit_order, replace_order, place_complex_order, edit_complex_order — require a single-use confirmation token from their matching dry_run_* tool, valid 60 seconds and bound to a hash of the arguments. The other seven carry none: the two order cancels and five watchlist/quote-alert mutations.

install.note: Install by cloning and building: no image is published and no npm package, so no docker pull and no npx. A Dockerfile is included for building your own.

cloneAndBuild.description: Clone, build, and point your MCP client at dist/index.js.
notes: args must be an absolute path; MCP clients do not resolve ~ or relative paths.
A .env file is NOT auto-loaded. Credentials come from the client's env block, or the launching shell.
The block above pins the sandbox; production is what you get if you drop it.

rateLimits.scheme: Per-second, from tastytrade's published limits, charged in-process once per tool call.
rateLimits.howItApplies: Every call is charged against the global cap, plus an endpoint's ceiling when it reaches one above. tradingStatus has no tool: the safety layer charges it before every live submit. A tool absent from the table has no per-endpoint ceiling, though the destructive tools also sit behind an unpublished internal cap: a burst of submissions can be refused while the global cap has room. Exhaustion returns a rate_limit_exceeded ToolError carrying retry_after_ms.
rateLimits.planningNote: A bucket holds one second of budget, so a 1/sec endpoint permits one call and then a full second of waiting. Size polling per endpoint, not per agent, and stream live prices over DXLink.

notes: The endpoint defaults to PRODUCTION (https://api.tastyworks.com): real accounts, real funds. TASTYTRADE_ENV=sandbox selects https://api.cert.tastyworks.com; prod, live, cert, staging and sbx are also understood. A value the server cannot read resolves to the sandbox and warns on stderr.
The sandbox serves no market data (HTTP 502 on every market-data and market-metrics route), which is why production is the default.
Production is announced three ways: a LIVE TRADING stderr banner, the environment named in the initialize instructions, and an environment member (production, sandbox or other) on every order result.

TASTYTRADE_READ_ONLY: 1 or true withholds and refuses every write and destructive tool; 0, false, empty and unset allow them (case-insensitive, trimmed). Any other value ENABLES read-only mode and warns — a setting that cannot be read is never permission to move money.
MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL_USD caps single-order buying-power impact; the default is 50000.

TASTYTRADE_API_URL is an explicit base URL for a gateway or a test double, and it wins over TASTYTRADE_ENV. An unrecognised host in it is a startup refusal, not a warning: the server exits rather than POST the refresh token and client secret there. TASTYTRADE_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_API_HOST=<hostname> acknowledges one by name.
A resources/read is charged the per-endpoint ceilings of the tool reaching the same endpoint, plus the global cap at its declared fan-out.
